newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends down on higher dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends down on higher dollar demand.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka weakened to close at 42.5485/5500 to the dollar in interbank trading, compared with the previous 42.5450/5495, dealers said.

They said the taka was quoted lower at 42.5475/5500 per dollar at the opening and slipped further on higher demand for the U.S. currency, mostly from importers. "There was renewed import activity. The rates hit the central bank band of 42.35/55," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates ended at 4.0 percent to 4.75 percent compared with the previous 4.25-4.75, dealers said.
